Class Wedge `(F : C^op ∏ C ⟶ D) := { wedge_obj : D ; wedge_map {x : C} : wedge_obj ~{D}~> F (x, x) ; ump_wedges {x y} (f : x ~{C}~> y) : bimap[F] id f ∘ wedge_map ≈ bimap[F] (op f) id ∘ wedge_map }

statement_record.book: An end of S : C^op x C -> X is a universal wedge <e, ω> from the constant e to S: a dinatural ω : e =.> S such that every wedge β : x =.> S factors uniquely as β_a = ω_a . h through a unique h : x -> e; the object e = ∫_c S(c,c).
statement_record.intree: Class End over F : C^op ∏ C ⟶ D bundles the universal `end_wedge : Wedge F` (apex + legs `wedge_map` satisfying the extranaturality `ump_wedges`) with `ump_ends`: for every wedge W a unique mediator u with `wedge_map[end_wedge] ∘ u ≈ wedge_map[W]`.

evidence.intree_statement: Definition Coend `(F : C^op ∏ C ⟶ D) := @End (C^op) (D^op) (F^op)  -- the coend is the end in the opposite categories, i.e. the universal (initial) cowedge
Lemma coend_ump (E : Coend F) (w : D) (i : ∀ x, F (x, x) ~> w) (cond : Cowedge_cond w i) : ∃! u : coend_obj E ~{D}~> w, ∀ x : C, u ∘ coend_inj E ≈ i x
Definition Build_Coend (w : D) (i : ∀ x, F (x, x) ~> w) (cond : Cowedge_cond w i) (ump : ...) : Coend F  -- covariant accessors coend_obj/coend_inj/coend_cowedge/coend_med

statement_record.book: A coend of S : C^op x C -> X is a universal wedge <d, ζ> from S to the constant d: ζ : S =.> d couniversal among dinatural transformations to constants; the object d = ∫^c S(c,c), dual to the end.
